sql: with candidates as ( select distinct market_ticker from live_orders where strategy='Cmmsell10' and action='buy' and status in ('pending','unknown','submitted','resting','partial','filled') ), latest as ( select distinct on (p.market_ticker) p.market_ticker, coalesce(p.quantity_fp, p.quantity) as qty, p.captured_at from positions p join candidates c on c.market_ticker=p.market_ticker order by p.market_ticker, p.captured_at desc ) select (select count(*) from candidates) as cap_candidates, count(*) filter (where l.qty is null) as no_snapshot, count(*) filter (where abs(l.qty)<=0.01) as flat_settled, count(*) filter (where abs(l.qty)>0.01) as really_open, (select count(*) from candidates) - count(*) filter (where abs(l.qty)<=0.01) as cap_counts, max(l.captured_at)::text as newest_snapshot from candidates c left join latest l on l.market_ticker=c.market_ticker
